---
title: "Example report"
date: today
params:
  summary: "results/example/summary.tsv"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
source("workflow/scripts/common/plotting.R")
summary <- read_tsv(params$summary, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Samples

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Per-sample totals"
knitr::kable(summary)
```

## Totals by group

```{r}
#| label: fig-totals
#| fig-cap: "Total counts per sample"
ggplot(summary, aes(group, total, colour = group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total counts") +
  theme_project()
```
